modelLabel.en: Merdith et al. 2021 plate model · v1.2.4
modelLabel.zh: Merdith 等 2021 年板块模型 · v1.2.4

method.en: Continents are today's coastlines (Merdith et al. 2021, CC BY 4.0) rotated with the same model's rotation file. Each frame is the model's position for the selected age, computed in the browser by interpolating between the model's total rotation poles the way GPlates does (checked against pyGPlates to within 0.001°). Between poles, positions come from this interpolation, not from separate observations. Plates are rigid; east–west positions are a model convention.
method.zh: 大陆轮廓是今天的海岸线（Merdith 等 2021，CC BY 4.0），按同一模型的旋转文件转动。每一帧都是模型在所选年代给出的位置：浏览器按 GPlates 的方法在模型的总重建极之间插值计算（与 pyGPlates 核对，误差不超过 0.001°）。两个极之间的位置来自插值，不是独立观测。板块按刚体处理；东西方向的位置是模型约定。
